[P3] Reconsider the untested cyclic-parent recovery

This default adds a recovery path for cyclic parent graphs, duplicated in Execution view, but none of the tests supplies a cyclic graph. The missing-ancestor tests remain acyclic and do not require this fallback. That violates rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and establish whether cyclic metadata is a supported input at all; relying on the operation hierarchy's tree structure would be simpler than adding untested recovery behavior.
